q: What are the six sections of the Personal AI Playbook?
options: Reports, Emails & messages, Numbers, My-role documents, My privacy rules, My verification checklist
ChatGPT, Gemini, Sheets, Canva, WhatsApp, Calendar
Goals, Budget, Timetable, Contacts, Passwords, Notes
Day 1 to Day 7, in order, with no other sections
explanation: The Playbook holds your real prompts under six headings: Reports, Emails & messages, Numbers, My-role documents, plus your privacy rules and verification checklist.

q: What is the weekly Playbook review ritual?
options: Rebuild the Playbook from scratch every week
Ten minutes: review this week's AI output, keep what worked, fix one weak prompt
Ask AI to rewrite the whole Playbook daily
Delete prompts you have not used this week
explanation: Once a week, ten minutes: look at what AI produced, keep what worked, fix one weak prompt. Fixing prompts weekly is the habit that makes the course permanent.

q: A new AI tool is trending every few weeks. What does the lesson advise?
options: Chase every new tool and master each one
The moves do not change — test new tools against your Playbook using give real material, specify role and format, verify the output
Only use tools your friends recommend
explanation: Tools change monthly; the moves — real material, role and format, verification — do not. New tools are tested against your Playbook, not against hype.

q: What does the verified certificate attest to?
options: Mastery of AI engineering and employment readiness
Course completion and a submitted playbook — exactly that, nothing more
Accreditation equivalent to a university diploma
A guaranteed income from AI services
explanation: The certificate is truthful by design: it attests to completing the course and submitting the Playbook. No competencies beyond that, no hours claimed, no accreditation claimed.
